**Dr. Eleanor Marsh**  
Department of Computer Science  
University of Techtonic  
123 Innovation Drive  
Techtonic, TX 98765  
Email: emarsh@techtonic.edu  

To Whom It May Concern,  

Patrick Doyle and I collaborated on a cloud-native project during his capstone year, where he led the architecture of a microservices-based platform for a regional logistics firm. As a professor, I observed his technical rigor and collaborative mindset firsthand.  

Patrick’s expertise in CI/CD pipelines significantly reduced deployment latency at NexaCorp, cutting average release cycles by 40%. His Docker/Kubernetes implementation enabled seamless containerization, lowering infrastructure costs by 30% while improving scalability. During a critical outage, his monitoring tools—leveraging Prometheus and Grafana—identified a PostgreSQL bottleneck, reducing query latency by 50% within 24 hours.  

A standout moment occurred when Patrick rearchitected a monolithic system into microservices, enabling the team to scale during a holiday sales surge without downtime. His REST API design, built with Python, also improved third-party integration efficiency by 25%. These efforts underscore his ability to balance technical depth with pragmatic problem-solving.  

Patrick is a reliable, self-driven professional who consistently prioritizes team success. His meticulous approach to infrastructure as code—using Terraform—minimized configuration drift, saving hours of manual troubleshooting.  

I recommend Patrick without reservation. His technical acumen and ethical work ethic make him an exceptional asset to any team.  

Sincerely,  
Dr. Eleanor Marsh
